cards.mechanism: Narrow per-element loads issue one device-memory transaction per element; widening the access makes each request span a full transaction, so transactions per request falls toward one.
evidence_of_implementation: in the diff, the hot loop issues one wide load per lane instead of one narrow load per element
in the disassembly, the overweighted wide-load class rises while the narrow-load class falls
cards.scope_of_change: indexing and load width only; the algorithm is unchanged
